_comment: SVP/VideoProc Y-channel SR. align=64 pads H/W to multiples of 64 for model reshape. color_format_auto=1 auto-selects I420_Three_Planes for yuv420p input or RGB for rgb24. normalize_input/normalize_output=false: model operates on raw [0,255] float32 pixel values. output_passthrough_dims=true: output H/W are forced to match input H/W (no scale change).
name: VideoProc
